Class RagQueryConfig

java.lang.Object
tech.kayys.wayang.rag.schema.RagQueryConfig
public class RagQueryConfig extends Object
Top-level configuration DTO for the RAG executor. Fields mirror the context keys consumed by RagExecutor.execute().
